contexts.text: To dwell in a tent () = the Holy of love. Illustrated.
Tent = what is celestial. AC 414:2.
This is to dwell in tents.
The tents of Ham () = the worship therefrom. AC 3325:13.

The midst of a tent () = the principal of faith; for tent = charity, or worship from charity. Charity is the inmost thing of faith and worship; and this is the midst of the tent. That tent = the Holy of love, or charity. References.
He shall dwell in the tents of Shem () = that the internals of worship may be in the externals.

Tents = the Holy of love, and worship thence. To sojourn and dwell in tents was a wonted formula among the Ancients, by which was signified holy worship; for the reason that the Most Ancients not only sojourned with tents, but also dwelt in tents, and performed holy worship therein. AC 1293. AC 3312.
That tents = holy worship. Illustrated.
He stretched his tent () = the holy things of faith; for a tent = the Holy of love, consequently the Holy of faith from love. His stretching his tent there = that this was now beginning.
Even to the place where his tent was before () = to the holy things which there were before... A tent = the holy things of faith... thus the celestial things which the Lord had...
(Lot) had flock, and herd, and tents () = the things with which the external man abounds.
The tents = the worship of that (external man) which was separating itself from the internal.
Tents, in the opposite, = worship not holy. Illustrated.
He tented as far as Sodom () = extension to cupidities.
Abraham tented... ()... To tent, that is, to move and fix a tent, = to be conjoined; for a tent = the Holy of worship, by which the external man is conjoined with the internal.
He was sitting at the door of the tent () = the holy state of love in which He then was. AC 5152.
A tent = the Lord as to the Holy of love.
Behold in the tent () = in what was holy, (Explained.)
Sarah heard at the door of the tent () = that rational truth was near what was holy.
The tent, which was outside the ark, = the Lord's Kingdom.
The tent of Sarah his mother () = the sanctuary of truth in the Divine Human. A tent = what is holy, thus a sanctuary.
Tents and flocks = goods of the Spiritual Church.
Dwelling in tents () = worship therefrom.
Hence it was commanded that they should make a tent...
The tent of David () = the Church and worship of the Lord. ( = the good of love and of charity from the Lord. AC 4926:3.) AC 9163:end.
Hence it was culled the tent of meeting.
Isaac stretched his tent there () = what was holy there.
The tent was a representative of the three Heavens, thus of the celestial and spiritual things of the Lord's Kingdom.
Tents = holy things of good.
Jacob fixed his tent in the mount () = the state of that love.
Laban came into the tent of Jacob, and into the tent of Leah, and into the tent of both the handmaids () = that in their holy things there were not such truths.
In the representative Church they had tents or tabernacles, and Divine worship in them... because tents or tabernacles = the Holy of love and of worship.
They were therefore restricted... to a tent in common, which was called the tent of meeting.
Under Hut, see this reference.
Where he had stretched his tent = what was holy.
To stretch the tent = the progression of what is holy, here, towards interior things.
As the tent of meeting with the ark represented Heaven...
Tent = what is holy.
They have tents also in Jupiter. Described.
They take their meals in their tents.
Tent, here () = a society as to good; for a tent here has the like signification to a house; for when they were sojourning they were in tents.
They came into the tent () = the Holy of union... because love is union. Hence to come into the tent = to be united from holy love.
The Second Heaven is here represented by the habitation and the tent.
The curtains from the goats for the tent which was round about. AC 9615.
Enlarge the place of thy tent () = the Holy of worship from the good of love.
My tents are laid waste () = holy worship from the good of love. ( = the Church. AC 9854:3.) AE 724:16.
The tent over the habitation = the external of Heaven; for the habitation = Heaven; and the tent which covered it above = its external.
The Heaven which is represented by the tent of meeting...

In the tent of meeting () = the Lord's presence; for the tent was made that the Lord might meet Moses and Aaron there, and also the sons of Israel; and on this account the Holy of worship was instituted there. Illustrated.
For the tent represented Heaven; and Heaven is Heaven from the Lord's presence there.
For the habitation, and the tent = Heaven.

When they go into the tent of meeting () = in worship representative of all things of Heaven and the Church... For the tent represented Heaven where the Lord is... Moreover all the worship at that time took place in the tent...
The tent of meeting = Heaven.
The altar which was placed at the door of the tent, represented the Lord as to Divine good; and the tent of meeting represented the Lord as to Divine truth.

As to the tent of meeting, by which is represented Heaven in which is the Lord... its inmost, where was the ark, represented the Third Heaven; the habitation, which was outside the veil, represented the Second Heaven; and the court, the First Heaven. AC 10268:2. AC 10338. AE 630:4. AE 700.
Before the tent of meeting () = for purification, the reception of truth from Heaven, and its conjunction with good; for the tent of meeting = Heaven where the Lord is.
The place before the tent, which is called its door, = the conjunction of truth and good...
The tent of meeting outside the veil represented the Spiritual Kingdom, or, what is the same, the Lord where He is present in the good of charity...
I will sanctify the tent of meeting () = what is receptive of the Lord in the Lower Heavens. The reason the tent of meeting = the lower Heavens, is that the altar = the higher ones. Explained.

Because the habitations of the Most Ancients were tents, a tent was constructed in memory of it which was used as a house of God, and the feast of tents was afterwards instituted in which they rejoiced from the heart.
Next, the tent itself is described, by which is signified Heaven and the Church which is from the foregoing things.

Thou shalt give it for the work of the tent of meeting () = conjunction with Heaven through the acknowledgement that all truths and goods are from the Lord... The tent of meeting = Heaven where the Lord is, thus also that which conjoins man with Heaven...
In their entering into the tent of meeting () = worship from the good of faith. Explained.
For that tent (where Aaron and his sons made the daily ministration) represented the Heaven where spiritual good reigns.
Thou shalt anoint with it the tent of meeting () = in order to represent the Divine of the Lord in the Heavens... The tent of meeting = Heaven in the whole complex. Explained.

Thou shalt put of it before the testimony in the tent of meeting () = the worship of the Lord in Heaven and the Church... The tent of meeting Heaven; and (therefore) the Church also; for the Church is Heaven on earth.
The tent of meeting and the ark for the testimony () = a representative of Heaven in general, where the Lord is. Explained.

Moses took the tent () = the Holy of worship, of the Church, and of the Word; for the tent, in the supreme sense, = the Lord, and also Heaven and the Church; and, in the relative sense, all the Holy of Heaven and the Church, and hence also the Holy of worship and the Holy of the Word... The reason a tent = these things, is that the Most Ancients dwelt in tents, and also held in them their holy worship...
That by a tent are signified these holy things;, and, in special, the Holy of worship. Illustrated.
Tents () = the goods of the Church, curtains, its truths.
As tents = the goods of the Church and of worship, therefore, in the opposite sense, tents = the evils of worship and of the Church. Illustrated.
To stretch the tent () = to provide, dispose, and ordinate the things which are of the Church and of worship.

Recalled it the tent of meeting () = the external of worship, of the Church, and of the Word, in which are internal things... Meeting, in the sense of the letter, means the meeting (or assembly) of the sons of Israel; but in the internal sense is signified the assembly of the truths and goods of the church... AC 10548.
The tent = the Holy of the Word, of the Church, and of worship.
Their dwellings (in the Fifth Earth) were low houses in the form of tents, such as the ancients had. Described.
A union like that of the two tents in the breast, which are called the heart and lungs.

Two tents were seen, one directly above the place (where the meteor fell); and the other at the side, towards the south... A Spirit fell from Heaven and was cast into the (first) tent; and I was in the other... In the door of this I stood, and saw the Spirit in the other also standing in the door of his tent; and I asked him why he fell...
The tents of Judah () = the Celestial Kingdom.
To enlarge the place of the tent = that they have worship from good. AE 600:12.
The tent = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom; and that part of the tent which was within the veil = the Lord's Celestial Kingdom. Explained.
Tents of securities () = the derivative goods of love and of worship without infestation by evils and falsities.
The tent of meeting represented Heaven. AE 727:11. AE 1042:5.
To hide in Thy tent () = in the Divine truth.
Ohola and Oholibah, that is, the tent, or habitation of God; for this = Heaven where are the Divine truth and the Divine good, and thence also the Church. AE 576:6.
The sacrifices at the door of the tent represented the worship of the Lord, because the altar, and also the tabernacle, represented Heaven where the Lord is present...
This was the court of the tent of meeting, (which last) represented Heaven.
The three Heavens were represented by the tent. References. AE 700. AE 700:4, Explained. AE 700:33, Explained.
Thorns shall be in their tents () = the falsity of evil in the worship.
Surely I will not enter within the tent of my house () = that he will not enter into and know the holy things of the Church.

The primary representatives of the Lord, and thence of Heaven and the Church, were the tent of meeting... the altar... and afterwards the temple... with the difference that the tent of meeting was a more holy representative...
The tents of Jacob () = all things of the Church... tents = its goods; habitations, its truths.

Tabernacle = the Church from those in the good of love to the Lord; tent = the Church from those in truths from this good... Therefore tabernacle = the doctrine of the good of love; and tent, the doctrine of truth from this good; thus tabernacles, in the plural, = the goods of the Church and of doctrine; and tents, the truths of the Church and of doctrine. Illustrated. AE 799:20.
A tent () = the Church which is in the truths of doctrine.
